in_marathi.name: Niharidevi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of fertility
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niharidevi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niharidevi is a goddess in Hindu mythology, known as the goddess of fertility and nourishment. She is depicted as a beautiful woman with four arms and a golden complexion. Her four hands hold a lotus, a bowl of rice, a mace, and a bell. Niharidevi is often worshipped by married women for a safe and prosperous pregnancy and childbirth.
